scene.name: stairs_up
scene.label: Stairs curriculum / 2 mm / 3 steps / extended last platform to 4m

limitations: Lowest foot collision-mesh vertex can switch; trace is not a fixed material point or a reachable workspace.
Peak sampled at 1kHz; geometry/contacts at non-refresh peak may precede integrated positions by one physics step. Full traces use existing 200Hz forward passes.
Tracking correction bounds the desired target before unchanged slew limit, not actual joint error or actual velocity.
Extended-platform 40s test changes only final platform extent from 1.8m to 4m and is a separate diagnostic. Original 40s failure retained.
Fixed-condition checks are not multi-seed robustness or hardware validation. Original 4mm target remains failed.
